en.headline: Customs seizes 62 live birds at Lok Ma Chau Spur Line
en.dek: A 22-year-old Mainland man was arrested after officers found 62 suspected illegally imported live birds valued at about HK$12,000 in his baggage.
body: Hong Kong Customs on Monday seized 62 suspected illegally imported live birds with an estimated market value of about HK$12,000 at the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line Control Point.

Officers intercepted a 22-year-old incoming Mainland male passenger at the Arrival Hall. Upon examination, the birds contained in cages were found in his personal baggage and he was arrested. The case was handed over to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department for further investigation.

Under the Public Health (Animals and Birds) Regulations, it is an offence to import any bird unless it is accompanied by a valid health certificate. The maximum penalty upon conviction is a fine of HK$25,000. Customs urged the public to report suspected illegal import of live birds via its 24-hour hotline or online channels.

zh.headline: 海關落馬洲支線檢62隻懷疑非法進口活鳥
zh.dek: 海關周一在落馬洲支線管制站截獲一名22歲內地男旅客，在其行李檢獲62隻估計市值約1.2萬元的活鳥，並將其拘捕。
body: 香港海關周一在落馬洲支線管制站檢獲62隻懷疑非法進口活鳥，估計市值約1.2萬元。
關員在抵港大堂截查一名22歲內地男旅客，在其個人行李發現鳥籠內的活鳥，隨即拘捕他。案件已交予漁農自然護理署跟進調查。
根據《公眾衛生（動物及禽鳥）規例》，進口任何禽鳥須附有有效健康證明書，否則屬違法，最高可被罰款2.5萬元。海關呼籲市民如發現懷疑非法進口活鳥，可透過24小時熱線或網上渠道舉報。
